feature: Camera keys ease in and out
summary: A camera move eases the way any other key does: right-click a diamond on the Camera row for the key eases, pick a diamond and use the timeline bar's Easing, or shape the stretch with the Curve row in the Camera section.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: Scripts/playtest/camera-keys-ease-walk.json.

try.do: Open a recording, click empty canvas, and key Camera depth at 1s (0) and 3s (400).
Right-click the first diamond on the Camera row.
Choose Linear, then do the same on the second diamond, and play the push in.
Put the playhead at 2s and read the Curve row under Camera Y.
Click the first diamond and choose Ease In and Out from Easing at the right of the timeline bar.
Choose Ease out back on the Camera section's Curve row and play it.

evaluate: Does the right-click on a camera diamond feel like the same menu as a key on a layer's lane?
Is the Curve row under the camera values where you would look for how the camera travels?
Is it right that one diamond eases every camera value keyed at that moment, rather than one value at a time?
Does a fresh camera push in already easing in and out (ticked Ease In and Out) match what you expect?
rough: No mock covers easing camera keys: video-depth.html only says keyed camera moves show on a thin row, so the menu and the Curve row follow a layer key's.

The camera diamond offers the key list (Linear, Ease In, Ease Out, Ease In and Out, Hold, Bezier) as a layer key does today; if keys move onto the ten curves, the camera row moves with them (decision on wherever-you-ease-a-key-a-segment-a-row-or-the-b).
The Camera row has no graph, so Bezier can be ticked but has no handles to drag there; it keeps the shape the key had until handles exist on the camera row.
The Curve row has no Between the keys header with its question mark as a layer's does; it sits under the camera values with only a hover tip.
